title: Reckoner strategies
description: A centred section on a warm page: a small glowing-square eyebrow, a 32px statement whose last words fade to camel, and two square hairline cards side by side (stacked on phones), each with a 120px artwork, a title, one line of detail and a sand button. The statement fades in as it scrolls into view; cards warm to ivory over half a second on hover.
notes: card artwork slots are 120×120; empty, they're muted squares
CSS scroll-driven fade (inside @supports); static HTML shows everything
